data.name: Last Offer: Car Dealer
data.detailed_description:
Last Offer: Car Dealer is an open-world car trading and dealership simulation game.

Explore the city, discover vehicles for sale, inspect their condition, negotiate with owners, and decide whether a deal is actually worth your money. Bring the cars you buy back to your dealership, prepare them for sale, and wait for the right customer.

A cheap car is not always a good deal. An expensive car is not always a bad investment.

Learn the market, understand your customers, and know when to walk away.

Find, Inspect and Negotiate

Drive through the open world and discover cars that are up for sale.

Check their mileage, condition, and market value before making an offer. Negotiate with the seller and try to get the best possible price.

One bad purchase can wipe out your profit.

Build and Grow Your Dealership

Your dealership is more than just a place to park cars.

Fill your showroom with vehicles, organize your stock, and gradually turn a small business into a larger and more professional dealership.

As your business grows, new opportunities become available.

Negotiate With Customers

Customers can visit your dealership, walk around the showroom, and inspect the vehicles that interest them.

They may ask questions about a car, request information, and negotiate the price with you.

Not every customer will buy.

Sometimes letting a customer walk away is better than accepting a bad deal.

Customize Your Cars

Give your vehicles their own character before putting them up for sale.

Modify their appearance, customize different parts, and create cars that stand out from the rest of your stock.

Some modifications may make a vehicle more attractive to buyers, while others are simply about creating something that fits your own style.

Drive Through an Open World

Your business does not exist inside a menu.

Drive the cars you purchase, explore the city, and travel between your dealership, workshops, and other locations yourself.

The vehicles you trade are also the vehicles you drive.

The Hidden Side of the Business

Not every opportunity in the city is completely legal.

Certain unusual and restricted vehicles can take you beyond ordinary dealership business.

Meetings may happen at different locations and at specific times. Buying the vehicle is only the beginning — getting it safely back to your own garage can also be part of the deal.

Higher risk can mean higher profit.

If you make it back.

Buy low. Negotiate hard. Sell smart.

Every negotiation has an ending.

Make yours the Last Offer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
